setup_logging: setup logging for multiple processes with stdout and optional file output to an output directory
get_logger: get a named logger instance or the root logger from the logging hierarchy
log_json_stats: log a dictionary of statistical information as formatted JSON with decimal precision
suppress_print: suppress all print output from the current process by replacing the built-in print function
cached_log_stream: open a cached log file stream with append mode and automatic cleanup on exit
